instances.claim: This tells me that the film has already described a force pulling the cent out of physical existence — a dematerialization, a melting, a dissolution — and a context that was named and held the object up against it.
instances.why: "Remained" and "buoyed into physicality" are continuations: both presuppose a prior state in which the object's physical existence was in question, and "its context" is a definite phrase pointing at a context the draft never names. Lines 1–4 establish only a price discrepancy and a production count, neither of which puts the object's physicality at risk, so the sentence pushes against a state of affairs that is absent from the piece.

instances.claim: This tells me that the film introduced a specific, bounded set of Cents belonging to the work — a known number of them, distributed and handled — whose members started out identical to one another.
instances.why: "Each object, initially identical" and "Every Cent" quantify over a fixed collection, and "initially identical" is a claim about that collection's membership; line 4 counts all Lincoln cents ever minted, not the objects of the work, and every other mention of the work's object is singular ("the readymade," "the object," "a cent"). The one missing premise — a bounded set of the work's Cents — is what leaves both lines floating.
